definitions.explanation: The second-highest rank in professional sumo wrestling, just below yokozuna (grand champion). Achieving ōzeki requires consistently strong tournament results.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{大関|おおぜき}に{昇進|しょうしん}した。
{大関|おおぜき}は{横綱|よこづな}に{次|つ}ぐ{地位|ちい}だ。
examples.english: Ōzeki is the rank just below yokozuna.

examples.japanese: {大関|おおぜき}が{二場所|にばしょ}{連続|れんぞく}で{負|ま}け{越|こ}すと、{関脇|せきわけ}に{陥落|かんらく}する。
examples.english: If an ōzeki has a losing record for two consecutive tournaments, they are demoted to sekiwake.

notes:
USAGE:
The sumo ranking system ({番付|ばんづけ}) from top to bottom for the top division: {横綱|よこづな} (grand champion), {大関|おおぜき} (champion), {関脇|せきわけ} (junior champion), {小結|こむすび} (fourth rank). Historically, {大関|おおぜき} was the highest rank before {横綱|よこづな} was established as a separate rank.

Promotion to {大関|おおぜき} typically requires about 33 wins over three consecutive tournaments. Unlike {横綱|よこづな}, an {大関|おおぜき} can be demoted for poor performance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大関|おおぜき}に{昇進|しょうしん}する: to be promoted to ōzeki
- {大関|おおぜき}{陥落|かんらく}: demotion from ōzeki
- {大関|おおぜき}{昇進|しょうしん}: promotion to ōzeki
- カド{番|ばん}{大関|おおぜき}: ōzeki on probation (must win to keep rank)
